name: private-corpus-datacloud-find-duplicates-result-type
salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture proves only Glade's local deterministic FindDuplicatesResult DTO type; it does not invoke Salesforce duplicate services and grants zero Salesforce parity.

source.content: @isTest private class PrivateCorpusFindDuplicatesResultTypeTest { @isTest static void findDuplicatesResultTypeIsAvailable() { Datacloud.FindDuplicatesResult result = new Datacloud.FindDuplicatesResult(); System.assertNotEquals(null, result); result.success = true; System.assertEquals(true, result.success); } }
